candidates.name: code_generalized_extract
candidates.hypothesis: Removing math-specific language from system prompt and implementing flexible output extraction that handles strings, dates, lists (not just numbers) improves robustness across diverse problem types without sacrificing numeric accuracy.

candidates.name: code_with_classification
candidates.hypothesis: Asking the model to classify problem type and computational approach before code generation produces better-quality code on first attempt by forcing explicit reasoning about solution strategy, improving generalization to new task types.
